12 Scoreboard

Seven global trends. Where Indonesian OD stands.

Aligned

Analytics & data

World: 70% of employers rank analytical thinking essential (WEF 2025).

Us: 46% name it the top needed skill; 49% run people analytics.

Aligned

Change at speed

World: 98% of executives plan org design changes within two years (Mercer 2026).

Us: 52% run change management.

Aligned

Skills over jobs

World: 63% of C-suite support skills-powered talent practices (Mercer 2026).

Us: 79% do job analysis; 57% competency work.

Watch

Agentic AI

World: Gartner 2026 frames the agentic AI question as ROI; Deloitte: 6% report great progress on human-AI design.

Us: 18.5% run digital, HRIS or AI projects.

Watch

Flatter structures

World: 41% saw layers cut (Korn Ferry), about 10% real flattening (Visier).

Us: org design is the top project theme (29%).

Gap

Wellbeing & engagement

World: 20% engaged (Gallup 2026); thriving down from 66% to 44% (Mercer 2026).

Us: only 41% run culture and engagement work.

Gap

Business impact

World: no like-for-like global figure; we flag this from our own data.

Us: 16% name proving impact as OD's top challenge; only 19% get very high support.

Survey figures: OD.ID survey 2025–26 (n=227). World figures: sources on the last slide. Gartner, Deloitte (6%), Korn Ferry and Visier come from the survey brief and were not re-checked.

16 Takeaways

Six lines worth taking home.

In Indonesia, OD is a second career: 54% of practitioners hold neither a Psychology nor an HR degree, and 52% joined after 3+ years in another function. Community is where the craft gets learned.

Most Indonesian OD practitioners work alone or almost alone: 34% are a team of one or none, yet they cover 7.5 of 14 OD roles on average.

Sponsorship unlocks practice: with very high management support, 68% run people analytics; with low support, 37%.

The workforce is ahead of the function on AI: 87% of Indonesian Gen Z use AI at work (Deloitte 2026), but only 18.5% of OD practitioners run digital, HRIS or AI projects.

Engagement is the open gap: Gallup puts global engagement at 20% in 2025, and only 41% of Indonesian OD practitioners run culture and engagement work.

Impact beyond boundaries comes back home: a WhatsApp group that started with 39 people reached 1,024, and returned scholarships, referrals and hires to our companies.

If you feel alone in your profession, you probably aren't. The others just haven't met yet. Maybe you are the one who connects the dots.

17 Method & sources

Method, caveats and sources

OD.ID practitioner survey

  • Fielded Aug 2025 to Aug 2026 in the OD.ID community.
  • 243 responses, cleaned to 227 unique people.
  • Self-selected sample: skews young, Greater Jakarta and engaged members.
  • Multi-answer items (degrees, roles) add up to more than 100%.
  • Left out on purpose: salary data, groups under about 40 people, keyword counts.
  • No respondent names, emails or employers are shown.

World vs us comparisons differ in respondents, definitions and years. Each one is flagged on its slide.

World sources

  • Gallup, State of the Global Workplace 2026
  • Mercer, Global Talent Trends 2026
  • WEF, Future of Jobs Report 2025 · Future of Jobs Report 2018
  • Deloitte, 2026 Gen Z and Millennial Survey
  • Focus Taiwan: Taiwan becomes a super-aged society (Jan 2026)
  • Singapore MOM: Workplace Fairness Bill passed
  • From the survey brief, not re-checked: PwC (69% vs 54%), Gartner 2026 (agentic AI ROI), Deloitte (6% human-AI design; 7 in 10 leaders), Korn Ferry (41%), Gallup span of control (12.1), Visier (~10%).
